Welcome to QFC Crunch: good food, good mood

Busy day, guests at home or a sudden craving? QFC Crunch keeps your freezer ready with crunchy, juicy and tender snacks that are ready in minutes. From seekh kababs and cutlets to momos, nuggets, sausages and seafood, every pack is made with quality, integrity and trust at its core.

We know the worry of ordering food: late delivery or a product that disappoints. That is why QFC Crunch focuses on consistent quality, halal food made under FSSAI Lic. No. 21521098000725, and quick home delivery that reaches you on time.

Ordering is simple

  1. Browse our products and pick your favourites.
  2. Call or WhatsApp us with your list and quantity.
  3. Share your delivery address.
  4. We deliver to your door: free on orders of ₹500 and above, ₹20 below ₹500.
🗓️

Plan ahead

Make a list for the week so you order everything in one go and never run short.

🏷️

Ask about offers

Ask our team about current offers and combos before you order.

❄️

Store it right

Keep your pack in the freezer and follow the storage instructions on the packaging.

How it works

From first call to opening day in five steps.

  1. 1

    Enquire

    Send us your details using the form below.

  2. 2

  3. 3

  4. 4

    Branding, stock and staff training.

  5. 5

    Launch

    Open your outlet with our marketing support.

Who can apply

  • Interest in food retail or distribution
  • A suitable shop, counter or storage space
  • Power supply for freezers
  • Local market knowledge
  • Ability to invest in the chosen plan

What we provide

  • QFC Crunch branding and signage
  • Product supply and storage guidance
  • Menu cards and price list
  • Staff training
  • Launch and ongoing marketing support

Frequently asked questions

How much do I need to invest?

It depends on the plan you choose. Contact us and we will share the current figures for Kiosk, Retail outlet and Distributor.

Do I need freezers?

Yes. Frozen products must be stored properly. We guide you on the right freezer and display setup for your plan.

Do I need food business experience?

No. Our products are ready to cook or heat to eat, and we train your staff.

How long does it take to open?

The timeline depends on your location and plan. We will give you a schedule once your plan is agreed.

Can I offer home delivery?

Yes. QFC Crunch offers free home delivery on orders of ₹500 and above, and you can follow the same model.

QFC Crunch is preparing to open franchise outlets in Lucknow with the support of government initiatives for entrepreneurs, creating jobs and new opportunities for the next generation.

Our vision

To become a trusted frozen food brand that brings good food, good mood and good livelihoods to every neighbourhood, starting from Lucknow and growing across Uttar Pradesh.

Our mission

To open QFC Crunch franchise outlets with the help of government initiatives, give young people real jobs and skills, and serve safe, halal, quality food at fair prices.

What we stand for

Six promises behind every QFC Crunch outlet.

🏪

Franchise growth in Lucknow

We are opening franchise outlets across Lucknow so every area can enjoy QFC Crunch close to home.

👩‍💼

Jobs for the new generation

Every outlet creates employment for local youth, from counter staff and cooks to delivery partners.

🎓

Skills and training

We train our team in food safety, customer service and running a small business, so they can grow with us.

🤝

Government support

We aim to work with government schemes that support entrepreneurs, self-employment and small businesses.

🌱

Entrepreneurs, not just employees

Young people, women and first-time business owners can become franchise partners with a trusted brand behind them.

✅

Quality you can trust

Halal food, FSSAI licensed, stored and delivered with care to keep every pack fresh and safe.
